description: This file defines the ACLAction class, which manages Access Control List (ACL) actions in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for adding, removing, and querying user permissions, handling security groups, and converting ACL data formats.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Represents access control list actions for modules in SuiteCRM, providing static and instance methods to manage permissions, read/write access levels, and generate permissions matrices.

methods.name: addActions
methods.description: Adds default actions for a category and type, inserting records into the acl_actions table if they do not already exist.

methods.name: removeActions
methods.description: Removes default actions for a specified category and type by marking them deleted.

methods.name: AccessColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with an access level, based on definitions in actiondefs.php.

methods.name: AccessName
methods.description: Returns the translated name for an access level.

methods.name: AccessLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with an access level, formatted in lowercase.

methods.name: getAccessOptions
methods.description: Builds select options for ACL access levels for a given action.

methods.name: getDefaultActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of default ACL actions with their access levels.

methods.name: getUserActions
methods.description: Returns a list of user-specific ACL actions, utilizing session cache or querying the database.

methods.name: langCompare
methods.description: Helper function to compare categories based on translated labels for sorting.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user or an ACLAction instance has access, considering ownership and group privileges.

methods.name: userNeedsSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks if a user requires security group ownership to perform an action.

methods.name: userHasAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has access to a specific category and action, considering roles, groups, and permissions.

methods.name: getUserAccessLevel
methods.description: Returns the numeric access level for a user on a specific category and action.

methods.name: userNeedsOwnership
methods.description: Checks if a user requires ownership privileges to perform an action.

methods.name: setupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Prepares and annotates categories array with display info, including access colors and labels.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns ACLAction data as an array, optionally limited to database fields.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Populates ACLAction object from an array.
